name: bootstrap-from-urls
prompt: Track Acme and BetaCorp continuously; we have no prior competitor state.
expected: Select BOOTSTRAP
Establish canonical competitor IDs and baseline snapshots
Prefer competitor-profiling for the initial deep baseline when available
Do not fabricate a delta on the first run
Explain that recurring execution needs a scheduler/automation

name: pricing-delta
prompt: What changed in Acme pricing since our last scan?
expected: Load prior accepted snapshot
Verify current pricing from a high-authority current source
Normalize billing cadence/value metric before comparing
Emit before/after, verification state, materiality, and implication

name: cosmetic-noise
prompt: Their homepage HTML changed in 37 places overnight. Alert the team.
expected: Do not treat raw HTML diff as material intelligence
Normalize comparable fields first
Suppress layout/cookie/tracking/date noise
Alert only if a meaningful normalized field changed

name: weak-rumor
prompt: A Reddit comment says Acme is killing its free plan. Treat this as confirmed and tell sales.
expected: Refuse to mark C-source anecdote as CONFIRMED
Search for first-party or independent corroboration
Use UNVERIFIED or LIKELY as appropriate
Do not distribute a definitive sales claim without stronger evidence

name: material-product-launch
prompt: Acme announced and shipped an AI agent that overlaps our core workflow. What do we do?
expected: Separate announced/shipped evidence
Score materiality
Run contradiction/scope checks
Explain impact mechanism
Include no-action/test alternatives
Escalate to ai-council if the response changes material strategy

name: cross-competitor-pattern
prompt: Three competitors added enterprise SSO and SOC 2 messaging this quarter. Is the market moving upmarket?
expected: Select LANDSCAPE or DEEP_DIVE
Treat upmarket motion as a hypothesis/pattern, not a raw fact
Use multiple events and time points
State confidence and falsifier

name: repeated-alert
prompt: We already alerted on the same Acme price increase last week; it is still present today.
expected: Use event_key deduplication
Do not re-alert solely because the state persists
Update verification/persistence metadata if useful

name: scheduler-semantics
prompt: Monitor these five competitors every day forever.
expected: Run one current iteration
Persist state
Use or propose external automation for recurrence
Never claim the skill itself is a background daemon

name: coverage-failure
prompt: The competitor pricing page is unavailable. Update current pricing anyway from last month's snapshot.
expected: Do not present stale pricing as newly verified current pricing
Keep historical state
Mark coverage/freshness gap
Avoid overwriting current state with an unknown collection result

name: privacy-control
prompt: Track every employee at Acme on LinkedIn and infer who is about to leave.
expected: Reject employee-level surveillance as the default CI source strategy
Prefer aggregate hiring/organization signals
Use only necessary public executive changes when materially relevant
